**Risk:** Adding 200 permanent staff doesn't take D-HQ past the next works-council headcount threshold, so the council size stays the same. The conversion does reduce tenure exposure by €9.4M. The risk score of 64 is still moderate. The headcount thresholds for works councils and the 18-month AÜG limit are set in the model as adjustable values. They are for validation by Vodafone Legal / labour counsel. This isn't legal advice.

**Recommended action:** The works-council position isn't a blocker, so the conversion could go to the owner role for approval. If you want, I can draft a conversion recommendation (a draft only, nothing gets executed). It would also help to check with labour counsel how close D-HQ is to the next seat threshold, in case more hiring follows.
